hero.heading: Orienteering across the woods, moors and coast of *Cornwall*.
hero.lede: Cornwall Orienteering Club (KERNO) has been promoting the sport across Cornwall since 1982. We run friendly events throughout the year - woodland, parkland, urban and coastal - for everyone from complete beginners to seasoned competitors. You don't need to be a member to take part; pick a course to suit yourself and navigate your way round at your own pace. Newcomers are always welcome, with guidance offered by club members.

stats.label: Covering
stats.value: Truro, Camborne, Falmouth, Newquay, Bodmin and across Cornwall

anytime.heading: New here? Useful links and resources
anytime.body: New to orienteering, or want to brush up before an event? Here are KERNO's guides, the permanent courses you can run any day, and our club policies.

social.heading: Event updates, photos, and last-minute changes.
social.body: Weather calls, course photos, and the post-event chat all live on our socials. Follow us to keep up to date with everything happening at Cornwall Orienteering Club.

widerSport.boBlurb: Cornwall Orienteering Club is a member club of British Orienteering, the national governing body for the sport in the UK, and of the South West Orienteering Association (SWOA).

newcomerCta.heading: The adventure sport of finding your way, *at your own pace*.
newcomerCta.body: Orienteering is an adventure sport where you use a map to visit checkpoints. The speed and the route are entirely up to you. It's a sport that rewards quick thinking and spotting the best route between checkpoints - and anyone can have a go, whatever your age or fitness.
